text: I feel invigorated by the purposeful atmosphere. The modern, clean lines of the space mirror the precision of thought and inquiry. Inside, the R+D wall inspires curiosity about human invention, progress, and the ways we shape and are shaped by technology. I am aware of the quiet hum of screens and the subtle presence of others, reminders of collective endeavor. Here, I feel both observer and participant in a continuous cycle of learning and creation.
